entities.name: Alcée Fortier
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alcée Fortier was a renowned Professor of Romance Languages at Tulane University in New Orleans. In the late 19th and early 20th century, he published numerous works on language, literature, Louisiana history and folklore, Louisiana Creole languages, and personal reminiscence. He had French Creole ancestry dating to the colonial period.

He had French Creole ancestry dating to the colonial period.
